containers.Command:
/app/bin/marginalia eval '# Runs to completion in its own container, synchronously, logging to stdout.
# A `docker compose run` container is not recreated by `docker compose up -d
# marginalia`, so a deploy no longer kills this halfway through.
{:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:marginalia)

import Ecto.Query
alias Marginalia.{Repo, Works, Links, Analysis, Stacks}
alias Marginalia.Works.Work
alias Marginalia.Analysis.Linker

folder = 26

say = fn msg ->
  IO.puts("#{DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_string()}  #{msg}")
end

t0 = System.monotonic_time(:second)
say.("=== folder #{folder} ===")

works = Work |> where([w], w.folder_id == ^folder) |> Repo.all()
todo = Enum.reject(works, &(&1.status == "read"))
say.("phase 1: read #{length(todo)} of #{length(works)}")

todo
|> Task.async_stream(
  fn w ->
    s = System.monotonic_time(:second)

    case Analysis.run(w) do
      {:ok, _} ->
        say.("read #{w.id} ok #{length(Works.list_nodes(w.id))} nodes #{System.monotonic_time(:second) - s}s")

      other ->
        say.("read #{w.id} FAILED #{inspect(other)}")
    end
  end,
  max_concurrency: 4,
  timeout: :infinity
)
|> Stream.run()

unread = Work |> where([w], w.folder_id == ^folder and w.status != "read") |> Repo.aggregate(:count)
say.("phase 1 done in #{System.monotonic_time(:second) - t0}s — #{unread} still unread")

steps = Stacks.Step |> where([s], s.folder_id == ^folder) |> Repo.all()
work_of = Map.new(steps, &{&1.ordinal, &1.work_id})

req = Enum.uniq(for s <- steps, r <- s.requires, do: {r, s.ordinal})
depended = req |> Enum.map(&elem(&1, 0)) |> MapSet.new()

isolated =
  steps
  |> Enum.filter(&(&1.requires == [] and not MapSet.member?(depended, &1.ordinal)))
  |> Enum.map(& &1.ordinal)

chain = for o <- isolated, o > 1, do: {o - 1, o}
pairs = (req ++ chain) |> Enum.uniq() |> Enum.sort_by(fn {a, b} -> {b, a} end)

say.("phase 2: #{length(pairs)} pairs (#{length(req)} requires, #{length(chain)} chained)")

done = :counters.new(1, [])

pairs
|> Task.async_stream(
  fn {from_ord, to_ord} ->
    case Links.get_or_create(work_of[from_ord], work_of[to_ord]) do
      {:ok, %{status: "linked"}} ->
        :counters.add(done, 1, 1)
        say.("skip #{from_ord}->#{to_ord} already linked (#{:counters.get(done, 1)}/#{length(pairs)})")

      {:ok, link} ->
        s = System.monotonic_time(:second)

        case Linker.run(link) do
          {:ok, %{kept: k, dropped: d}} ->
            :counters.add(done, 1, 1)
            say.("link #{from_ord}->#{to_ord} kept=#{k} dropped=#{d} #{System.monotonic_time(:second) - s}s (#{:counters.get(done, 1)}/#{length(pairs)})")

          other ->
            :counters.add(done, 1, 1)
            say.("link #{from_ord}->#{to_ord} FAILED #{inspect(other)}")
        end

      other ->
        say.("pair #{from_ord}->#{to_ord} not created: #{inspect(other)}")
    end
  end,
  max_concurrency: 8,
  timeout: :infinity
)
|> Stream.run()

say.("=== done in #{System.monotonic_time(:second) - t0}s ===")'
